items.raw_excerpt: Seoul prosecutors have alleged Evett in Seoul's Gangnam district served ants illegally imported from Thailand and the US in violation of food safety regulations.
items.summary_en: A Michelin-starred restaurant in Seoul's Gangnam district is on trial for using black ants imported from Thailand and the United States as a garnish on desserts. South Korean law only approves 10 insect species for human consumption, and ants are not on the list. The court will deliver its verdict on September 2, and no one was harmed from eating the dishes.

items.title_en: Michelin restaurant faces court for serving ants as dessert garnish
